subject: Post-call: SOC 2 binder + quick prioritization check
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Porter <elaine.porter@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 binder + quick prioritization check

Hi Elaine — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- You confirmed Kiteworks will evaluate hosted inference for customer-facing document summarization (high throughput, PII-sensitive).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 scope, data residency, and integration points for our SDK.
- Proposed pilot: 6-week evaluation, 2 models (small/med), and a short security Q&A with your InfoSec group.

I've attached the SOC 2 summary and a short integration checklist to save your team a pass-through. Next recommended steps:

1) Share the SOC 2 summary with your InfoSec — ETA?
2) Book a 30-minute technical Q&A (we can do next week) — is Tue/Wed morning PT better for your engineers?
3) If pilot looks good, we can outline a mutual action plan and estimate capacity/price.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2028.pdf (summary), integration_matrix_kiteworks.xlsx (integration checklist)

Links: HubSpot deal and the full SOC packet in case the team needs it: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcDeFgHjk/view

Thanks — happy to jump on whatever cadence makes this easiest for you.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Porter <elaine.porter@kiteworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Huang <daniel.huang@kiteworks.com>
Date: 2028-04-05T09:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 binder + quick prioritization check

Hi Grace — thanks for the packet and the clear recap. I looped in Daniel (engineering) and we'll pass this to InfoSec — initial read looks good but they typically take ~10 business days to complete a review.

A couple of quick asks from our side so we can scope the Q&A:
- Do you have a short latency/throughput guide for the hosted path (90th/95th pct) for the model sizes you suggested?
- Any customer-facing examples of embedding retention settings (we're sensitive to long-term storage).

We should be able to confirm a time for the Q&A by 2028-04-12. I'll update you once InfoSec has had a chance to look.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Porter
Sr. Technical Program Manager
Kiteworks
elaine.porter@kiteworks.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Porter <elaine.porter@kiteworks.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-19T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Checking timing — SOC 2 review + short walkthrough?

Hi Elaine — quick follow to see if your InfoSec had any blockers from the binder. Wanted to surface a couple of options to keep momentum:

- Option A: 20-min technical walkthrough (we'll cover hosted latency profiles, retention defaults, and integration sequence).
- Option B: Share a one-pager with measured 95th/99th pct latency for the two model sizes you flagged + sample SDK calls.

If it helps, we can run Option A as a short working session with Daniel and one of our infra engineers (Rishi) — available windows this week: Wed 4/20 (9–11am PT) or Fri 4/22 (10–12pm PT).

Also — if InfoSec needs a named point-of-contact for evidence requests (attestations, logs), we can expedite with our compliance team. Any preference on next step?

Thanks — appreciate the nudge back when you have a moment.

Best regards,
Grace
(Account thread continued)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Porter <elaine.porter@kiteworks.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 binder + quick prioritization check

Hi Elaine — looping in case my earlier note didn't reach you. Grace shared the binder and an integration checklist; we want to make this as frictionless as possible. If InfoSec needs anything urgent (syslogs, SOC 2 cert copy, KMS details), send me the asks and I will get the right people to respond within 48 hours.

If timing has shifted on your side and this is lower priority, that's helpful to know so we can adjust our pilot planning. If you'd like, we can also set a short working session with your security reviewer and our compliance lead (15–20 minutes) to clear outstanding questions quickly.

Thanks —
